[[File:JarJarBinks-FFp21.png|thumb|200px|Representative Binks]]
An '''Associate Planetary Representative''', also known as '''Junior Representative''' or simply '''representative''', was a junior member of a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senatorial]] delegation in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], and appointed by the [[Galactic Representative Commission]]. While only the delegation's [[Senator/Legends|senator]] could vote, the representatives were there to offer the views of political, ethnic, or religious minorities from the delegation's sector. If the Senator was unable to be at a meeting of the Senate, and/or had to take a leave of absence, he/she would appoint one of their delegation's representatives to serve as an acting senator. Representatives could be candidates for chancellorship, just like senators. In the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]], the position was replaced by the position of [[Legate]].

Possibly the most famous representative was the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] of the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]], who filled in for [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Senator Amidala]] on several occasions. His most important and best-remembered decision as acting senator was the suggestion that [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|emergency powers]] should be handed to the Supreme Chancellor, a suggestion which was met by thunderous applause and approval. After the death of Amidala and the reformation of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Binks would go on to serve as a full-time senator in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

Other notable representatives included [[Ainlee Teem/Legends|Ainlee Teem]], [[Zil Topur/Legends|Zil Topur]], [[Moje]], [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]], and [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]].
